title: Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record Galaxy Research says 13F filers added 49,229 BTC through U.S. spot bitcoin ETPs in Q3, lifting institutional holdings to a record 356,491 BTC as Wells Fargo became the largest holder. This post Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
